description: 2015 fixed empirical rosters; transported saved PPM calibration; annual draft comparison by top-K fitted-score ranking, not a stochastic calibration replay.
ability: unchanged ability_standardized from accepted frozen population; points per minute, population-standard-deviation z-score
congestion: full-roster mean of sigmoid(gamma_star*(A-theta)); includes focal player
theta_rule: linear quantile of A at 1 minus accepted ever-draftee fraction; follows fitted calibrator convention; independent of annual top-K count
selection_rule: deterministic highest fitted score, ties ascending athlete_id; calibration script's top-K ranking diagnostic; no probability clipping or post-score draws
primary_outcome: draft_year equals 2015; absent lookup ID treated as no recorded draft
primary_slot_count: number of accepted players with draft_year equals 2015
secondary_outcome: ever-drafted in saved lookup; includes players drafted after 2015; ranking diagnostic at its own observed count, same scores and theta
reference: ability-only ranking at the same slot count; lambda=0, all other settings fixed
peer_axis: unmodified leave-one-out mean of ability_standardized on actual rosters
